gate_report.scope: Historical compatibility diagnostics; use the shared indexed registry gate for clearance

vendor_v4_decision.binding_rule: representation-aware: rho vs all + dot-overlap vs dot-fields/top-N surfaces (IR-88-249E-01)
vendor_v4_decision.rationale: A continuous probability surface has no dots; literal >0 overlap against it is 1.0 for random dots too and cannot evidence copying. v4 binds rho against every raster and the dot test against dot emissions (literal) and continuous surfaces via their like-for-like top-N emission.
